The Dow Jones Industrial Average saw an increase at the opening bell. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 experienced a slight decline. Investors awaited earnings reports from major Wall Street companies.

title: Radico Khaitan Q1 Results: Profit jumps 76% to Rs 229 crore, revenue up at Rs 5,867 crore
description: Radico Khaitan recorded an impressive seventy-six percent uptick in net profit, reaching Rs 229.60 crore for the June quarter. The company's operational revenue rose by thirteen point two two percent, totaling Rs 5,867.69 crore. This quarter marks a record for the company's volume, top-line revenue, and profitability, significantly driven by a thirty-five point eight percent increase in Prestige and Above brand sales.

Quote of the day by John Templeton: "I have learned that the great opportunities are the places that have been neglected, where other people are not looking"
description: John Templeton's investing philosophy urges investors to seek overlooked opportunities with strong fundamentals rather than chase market trends. His contrarian approach highlights the importance of independent research, patience and long-term thinking to uncover undervalued investments before they gain widespread attention.

title: Market wrap: TCS, Eternal, HUL, BEL among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
description: Indian equity benchmarks ended marginally lower after surrendering early gains as IT stocks outperformed but weakness in FMCG, power and defence weighed on sentiment. Analysts expect Nifty to remain range-bound, with 24,050 as key resistance and 23,800 as crucial support.

title: L&T Q1 Results: Net profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 4,123 crore, revenue up 7%
description: L&T Q1 Results: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) on Tuesday reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 4,123 crore for the April-June quarter of the ongoing financial year 2027, marking nearly 14% year-on-year (YoY) rise from the Rs 3,617 crore net profit reported in the same period last year.

title: IPO pipeline robust with 245 DRHPs filed with Sebi, 175 receive observations: Equirus
description: India's IPO pipeline remains robust with 245 companies filing draft papers with Sebi, including 175 already cleared for launch. Strong domestic liquidity, resilient investor participation and improving market sentiment are driving equity fundraising despite global uncertainties and foreign fund outflows.

title: Rupee clings to two-week high as oil slides, intervention helps cement rise
description: The Indian rupee experienced a significant rebound on Tuesday, intensifying to its strongest position in two weeks. The decline in oil prices and the potential intervention by the central bank played crucial roles in this uplift, with state-run banks actively selling dollars to stabilize the currency. The Reserve Bank of India showed its commitment through daily interventions since Friday, signifying its intolerance for further currency dip.

title: Vedanta Aluminium shares in a sweet spot, says ICICI Securities; initiates coverage with Buy rating
description: ICICI Securities has initiated coverage on Vedanta Aluminium Metal (VAML) with a 'Buy' rating and a target price of Rs 520, implying over 19% upside. The brokerage expects strong earnings growth, driven by favourable aluminium prices, higher volumes, backward integration and lower costs. It also sees robust cash generation, debt reduction and long-term expansion supporting the company's outlook.
